message.content: In one of the conversations, LiHua mentions an amazing battle scene where she had to outsmart a giant enemy. The thrill of strategizing how to take them down was described as awesome, and the graphics made it even more epic. LiHua expresses her enjoyment of the battle scenes, which make every victory feel particularly rewarding. While the exact moment is not specified, this highlights one of the standout parts of the game that provides both strategic satisfaction and visual immersion.
